# Roadmap Generator Implementation Plan

> **For Claude:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task.

**Goal:** Add a Markdown-sourced roadmap with a generated view, validation in existing checks, and documented rules for agents.

**Architecture:** `docs/ROADMAP.md` is the source. A Node `.mjs` generator produces `docs/ROADMAP.generated.md`. A `roadmap:check` script ensures the generated file is up to date and is executed as part of `pnpm check`.

**Tech Stack:** Node.js, pnpm scripts, Markdown.

---

### Task 2: Implement generator script

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/roadmap/generate.mjs`

**Step 1: Implement generator**

```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { argv } from "node:process";

const ROOT = process.cwd();
const SOURCE = path.join(ROOT, "docs", "ROADMAP.md");
const OUT_DEFAULT = path.join(ROOT, "docs", "ROADMAP.generated.md");
const outArgIndex = argv.indexOf("--out");
const OUT =
  outArgIndex !== -1 && argv[outArgIndex + 1]
    ? path.resolve(argv[outArgIndex + 1])
    : OUT_DEFAULT;

const SECTION_ORDER = ["In Progress", "Planned", "Done"];
const STATUS_LABELS = {
  "In Progress": "In Progress",
  Planned: "Planned",
  Done: "Done",
};

function parseRoadmap(md) {
  const lines = md.split(/\r?\n/);
  let current = null;
  const items = [];

  for (const line of lines) {
    const section = line.match(/^##\s+(.*)\s*$/);
    if (section) {
      const name = section[1].trim();
      current = SECTION_ORDER.includes(name) ? name : null;
      continue;
    }

    if (!current) continue;

    const item = line.match(/^- \[( |x)\]\s+\[area:([^\]]+)\]\s+(.*)$/);
    if (!item) continue;

    items.push({
      status: current,
      area: item[2].trim(),
      text: item[3].trim(),
    });
  }

  return items;
}

function render(items) {
  const header = [
    "# Roadmap (Generated)",
    "",
    "> This file is autogenerated. Edit `docs/ROADMAP.md` and run `pnpm roadmap:gen`.",
    "",
    "| Area | Item | Status |",
    "| --- | --- | --- |",
  ];

  const rows = [];
  for (const section of SECTION_ORDER) {
    const sectionItems = items.filter((i) => i.status === section);
    for (const item of sectionItems) {
      rows.push(`| ${item.area} | ${item.text} | ${STATUS_LABELS[section]} |`);
    }
  }

  return [...header, ...rows, ""].join("\n");
}

const source = fs.readFileSync(SOURCE, "utf8");
const items = parseRoadmap(source);
const out = render(items);
fs.writeFileSync(OUT, out);
```

**Step 2: Commit**

```bash
git add scripts/roadmap/generate.mjs
git commit -m "build: add roadmap generator"
```

### Task 3: Add scripts and check integration

**Files:**
- Modify: `package.json`
- Create: `scripts/roadmap/check.mjs`

**Step 1: Add check script**

```js
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";

const ROOT = process.cwd();
const GENERATED = path.join(ROOT, "docs", "ROADMAP.generated.md");
const TMP = path.join(ROOT, "docs", ".ROADMAP.generated.tmp.md");

execFileSync("node", ["scripts/roadmap/generate.mjs", "--out", TMP], {
  stdio: "inherit",
});

const current = fs.readFileSync(GENERATED, "utf8");
const regenerated = fs.readFileSync(TMP, "utf8");

if (current !== regenerated) {
  console.error("Roadmap generated file is out of date. Run: pnpm roadmap:gen");
  process.exit(1);
}

fs.unlinkSync(TMP);
```

**Step 2: Wire scripts**

```json
{
  "scripts": {
    "roadmap:gen": "node scripts/roadmap/generate.mjs",
    "roadmap:check": "node scripts/roadmap/check.mjs",
    "check": "pnpm gen && pnpm test && pnpm roadmap:check"
  }
}
```

**Step 3: Commit**

```bash
git add scripts/roadmap/check.mjs package.json
git commit -m "build: add roadmap check to existing gate"
```
